subject: [AGY DIRECTIVE] MANDATORY: 200+ Gates + L5 Reasoning Filter Pre-Publication
body: HARD FOUNDER DIRECTIVE: All candidate plays, props, and parlays MUST run through the entire 200+ engine gate stack (Live Roster, Provenance/Freshness, JEV Mandatory, Real LCB, Stamp, Conjunction Gate, independentEdge decision check) + L1-L5 Reasoning Engine PRIOR to publishing any actual lines or picks.
